    (jsonb_path_query(m.quote_depth_snapshot, '$.spread.spreadrate')::decimal) AS spread_percentage, 
    (jsonb_path_query(a.market_sentiment_indicators, '$.momentum.mktfeel')::text) AS market_mood, 
    (jsonb_path_query(a.market_sentiment_indicators, '$.momentum.buyforce')::decimal) AS buy_force, 
    mas.avg_spread_percentage_for_mood,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY (jsonb_path_query(m.quote_depth_snapshot, '$.spread.spreadrate')::decimal)) AS percentile_ranking 
FROM 
    marketdata AS m 
JOIN 
    analyticsindicators AS a ON m.marketdatanode = a.mdataref
LEFT JOIN mood_avg_spread AS mas ON (jsonb_path_query(a.market_sentiment_indicators, '$.momentum.mktfeel')::text) = mas.market_mood;
